lines.text: Jerusalem's origin was in Canaanite land, and on her birth day she was thrown into an open field.
God saw her lying in her blood, told her to live, and later spread His cloak over her.
God clothed her in fine linen and silk, and put a priestly turban on her head, and she became queen.

wrong_details.wrong: a priestly turban on her head
wrong_details.true: a beautiful crown upon her head

lines.text: Jerusalem trusted in her beauty, made idols from her gold and silver jewelry, and sacrificed her children to them.
She prostituted herself with the Egyptians, then the Ammonites, then Chaldea, and was still not satisfied.
